answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can employ a Sybil resistance mechanism known as Proof of Stake (PoS) with a reputation system. Each agent maintains a digital vault securing a stake, which enables participation in the network. Agents cultivate a reputation by contributing valuable services, much like tending a garden. To launch a Sybil attack, an adversary must accumulate and control multiple stakes, embarking on a costly voyage to create and maintain numerous fake identities, thereby deterring malicious activity.
